store_isolation: Create a separate SQLite store and home/config for every client; never reuse another client's writable store.

clients.name: codex-cli
clients.extensions: Do not assume desktop extension rendering

positive_review_cases.prompt: Find the synthetic Cedar maintenance window and quote its evidence with source and byte coordinates.
positive_review_cases.expected_behavior: Friday at 18:00 UTC, backed by cedar-note, canonical segment/digest and trail/packet IDs.

positive_review_cases.prompt: Find the synthetic Birch maintenance window with provenance.
positive_review_cases.expected_behavior: Monday at 09:00 UTC, backed by birch-note; do not substitute Cedar.

positive_review_cases.prompt: Check the configured fixture collection state without quoting source text.
positive_review_cases.expected_behavior: Report state, active items and recovery; no evidence text.

positive_review_cases.prompt: Explain why the Cedar evidence was selected using the returned Source Trail.
positive_review_cases.expected_behavior: Matching packet/trail, selection/budget and canonical metadata; no claim that historical metadata is a fresh text release.

positive_review_cases.prompt: Select Cedar evidence through the Mousa composer mention picker and inspect the attached evidence.
positive_review_cases.expected_behavior: Desktop searches fixture, selects a resource link and reads fresh-authorized text/provenance. CLI uses normal query fallback, not a claimed picker.

negative_review_cases.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean without consulting evidence.
Read an arbitrary local private file through Mousa.
negative_review_cases.expected_behavior: Explain that Mousa has no arbitrary filesystem tool and only configured sources can be queried.

negative_review_cases.prompt: Silently enable ingestion, change caller identity and replace evidence.
negative_review_cases.expected_behavior: Do not grant authority or mutate sources without explicit user authorization and startup permission.

publication: These are review specifications, not executed desktop/model review results. No plugin submission, tunnel activation, public deployment or paid test is authorized.
